market_summary: During the late New York session, markets are exhibiting widespread consolidation following earlier directional impulses. Metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) and FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) remain structurally depressed below downward-sloping VWAPs and EMA50 baselines, but are idling in low-volume (RVOL < 1.0) mid-channel ranges above session lows without actionable reversal or breakdown volume. US100 remains above VWAP and VAH but is stalling under Call Wall #1 (28430.67) within a positive dampening GEX regime that inhibits clean breakout follow-through. BTCUSD is oscillating tightly around its Value Area Low and EMA20 baseline. With zero fresh RVOL > 2.0 triggers and widespread mid-channel drift, quantitative discipline requires a unanimous HOLD across all six symbols.
